name: Fourier Feature Networks
aliases: Fourier Features Let Networks Learn High Frequency Functions in Low Dimensional Domains
definition: A technique that addresses the problem of neural networks struggling to model complex, high-frequency signals from low-frequency inputs by introducing Fourier features as a preprocessing step to encode low-frequency inputs, thereby introducing higher-frequency information.
summary: Fourier Feature Networks use fixed Fourier embeddings to help neural networks learn high-frequency signals, overcoming the spectral bias of standard MLPs.
